parameters.metric: unclamped RGB MAE float64 of saved float32
parameters.interaction: E00+E11-E01-E10; both history slots available only
parameters.GT_scope: offline saved-candidate-set diagnostic only; never a deployable selector or student admission

four_mask_primary.meaning: GT minimum inside four saved whole-crop binary-mask predictions; per16tile error selection only

five_candidate_secondary_control.meaning: Separate GT minimum of same four saved outputs plus raw current input; not a history gate or accepted method

limitations: Post-failure descriptive GT diagnostic on the same selected development set; no independent test evidence.
Oracle and LOO-sign selectors both use target-derived errors and are not deployable raw-only decisions.
Each cached candidate came from a whole-crop binary mask. Tile-wise error selection does not execute a spatially varying input-mask gate; convolution neighborhoods mean its output may differ.
This is an upper bound on improvement only inside the saved candidate set, not arbitrary soft masks, retraining, or full-frame restoration.
Interaction is evaluated only where both history slots exist; boundary frames cannot supply all four physical states.
No model replay, student admission, original-gate change, threshold search, LPIPS or flow-temporal claim.
